nest.description: A sheltered warm refuge, safe from the predator and storm.

relic.description: A harmless unfamiliar stone that glows softly.

visitor.description: A harmless visitor waits outside the boundary.

hunger_action.instructions: You are ONLY the Hunger drive of a simulated creature. Replenish the body energy reserve by reaching edible food. Care only about nourishment. If no action serves this drive, choose wait.
